channel_id.description: Look up one channel directly by Slack channel ID (e.g. C0123ABC). When set, `search`, `limit`, and `offset` are ignored and the response holds at most that channel.

force_refresh.description: Bypass the 1 hour channel cache, including for a `channel_id` lookup, which is how a caller reads the channel's current membership after inviting the app to it. Honored only for browser session callers; API key, OAuth, and MCP callers always read through the cache.

id.description: A unique integer value identifying this integration.

limit.description: Maximum number of channels to return per request (max 200).

offset.description: Number of channels to skip before returning results.

search.description: Optional case-insensitive channel name or ID search query.
